# `admin.search.sync`

Reconcile the search index with the store

Site admins only. Heals FTS rows missing for live repos and users, then reports what it checked and fixed.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/search/sync`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin search sync`
- MCP: `admin_search_sync`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
